newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Cocoa seen lower, with uptrend nearing end.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Cocoa seen lower, with uptrend nearing end.

text.p: MAY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Analysts remain positive about cocoa, but the suspicion is setting in that its current uptrend could be short-lived.
Traders expected an opening around nine or ten stg lower.
"It's still in its current uptrend, but I suspect its time is limited," Elli Gifford, an independent analyst, said. "It should be alright for today."
She put the main resistance at 1,035 stg, but noted that the market was having trouble getting up to it. "It doesn't seem to like it above 1,025," she said.
LIFFE Cocoa Thursday peaked at 1,030 stg, before coming back to close at 1,023.
There is some support at Thurday's low of 1,010 stg, Gifford said, but "the real support's at 1,000."
Traders will be awaiting US first quarter cocoa grind statistics, which could show a rise of up to five per cent over the previous year.
New York cocoa ended firmer ahead of the U.S. cocoa grind data due Friday, but most of the gains were pared as the initial surge fizzled, traders said.
European buyers of cash cocoa have retreated this week in the face of a slightly higher market and continued strength in sterling against European currencies.
